CHAPTER 3 · ITEM 08 / 08

Gains and terms of trade

Productivity changes & trade生產力變化與貿易

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Analyze how a productivity change can alter comparative advantage and potential trade patterns. If both producers have identical opportunity-cost ratios, this simple two-good model has no comparative-advantage gain from specialization.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

生產力改變後要重算相對成本；只看產量上升不足以判斷貿易方向。兩方機會成本相同時，簡化模型沒有比較優勢收益。

Recalculate opportunity costs after productivity changes; absolute output growth alone does not determine trade patterns. Equal opportunity-cost ratios remove comparative-advantage gains in the simple two-good model.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A makes 10 X or 20 Y; B improves from 6 X or 6 Y to 6 X or 12 Y. Both now give up 2 Y per X. B 的改善令相對成本一致。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Both countries now sacrifice 3 Y per X. In the simple model, what happens to comparative-advantage gains? 相對成本相同時？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
